title: Phoenician masons build Solomon's temple
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Phoenician masons build Solomon's temple, about c. 10th century BC at Jerusalem, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the Hyram of Ty the king and Hyram Abif his his premier artificer um that's who built the temple

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino, talking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that the temple of the biblical King Solomon in Jerusalem was built by Phoenicians, an ancient seafaring people of the eastern Mediterranean. He says it was Hiram, king of the city of Tyre, and Hiram Abiff, his chief craftsman, who built it.
